message: PctGhost (libs/components/widget/src/ghost.ts) — `./other` exports `PctBlank` under that name; `./wrap` exports `PctMarker` under that name
description: The decorated `PctGhost` of `./widget` is exported by nothing; `./other` exports `PctBlank` under its name and `./wrap` exports `PctMarker` under it. The refusal names each entrypoint that holds the name, not the one the class sits in, and nothing else.
